Work and power: Work is force times displacement; power is work per time. 1 kWh equals 3.6 × 10⁶ J.
Kinetic and potential energy: Kinetic energy is ½mv² and potential energy mgh. Work done equals the change in kinetic energy.
Conservation of energy: Total energy is conserved. In free fall potential energy turns into kinetic energy.
Simple machines and mechanical advantage: Machines change force or direction. MA = load/effort; ideal MA of a ramp is length/height.
